summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 45001 Lead Implementer exam with practical OH&S MS implementation topics, case-study learning, and audit preparation.
audienceIntro: ISO 45001 Lead Implementer training is for professionals who maintain workplace safety, support OH&S system conformity, or plan to work as implementers, consultants, or officers. It is relevant when your responsibilities include coordinating implementation, worker participation, performance evaluation, or audit preparation.
modules: Operating and Maintaining the OH&S MS
prerequisites: To participate, you need basic knowledge of ISO management system standards, a general understanding of ISO 45001, and knowledge of management system implementation principles.
